description: Reserved matters application for the approval of details of access, appearance, landscaping, layout and scale for Plot NW04 located on Land to East of Brent Civic Centre, North of Engineers Way pursuant to Condition 1 of outline planning permission 18/0968 (dated 7 June 2018). The scheme comprises the erection of a new building ranging from 2 to 17 storeys in height providing a hotel (Use Class C1) with external landscaped terraces and ground floor commercial units providing floorspace for either Class A1 or A2 (Retail), A3 (Cafe and Restaurant), A4 (Drinking establishments), and/or A5 (Hot food takeaway), together with ancillary floorspace, associated plant, cycle storage, refuse and servicing provision and associated infrastructure; public realm enhancements including a new Civic Square, hard and soft landscaping, lighting, CCTV, street furniture and other associated works related to the development.This application provides information pursuant to the conditions below, with regard to Land to East of Brent Civic Centre, North of Engineers Way, Wembley.1 :  Reserved Matters in relation to Layout, Scale, Appearance, Access and Landscaping;8(a) :Indicative Phasing Plan;8(c) :Layout Details;8(d) :Highways Layout;8(e) :Cycle Storage;8(f) :Parking;8(g) :Details of CCTV;8(h) :Access;8(i) :Details of External Lighting;8(k) :Wind;8(l) :DHN Connections8(m) :Location of Services10 :Plant Details14(a, d and g) :Landscaping (partial discharge in relation to Public Realm landscaping);16 :Site Investigation & Remediation;18 :Car Park Management Plan;20 :Vehicular Access;23 :Sustainability Implementation Strategy;26 :Surface Water Drainage Scheme;27 :Piling Method Statement;29 :Coach Parking Plan.This application also provides information pursuant to the S106 obligations below, with regard to Land to East of Brent Civic Centre, North of Engineers Way, Wembley:First Schedule:Clause 6: The SE Pocket (Part 2)Clause 10.1: BREEAM at reserved matters stageClause 10.5: DemolitionClause 19: Brent Access Forum
